legalName: Mexico Tower Partners, S.A.P.I. de C.V.
summary: Mexico Tower Partners is the legal/original identity and Mexico Telecom Partners the current display brand for one continuing platform, so the queue's merge action is a false positive. A June 2026 BMV filing directly supports the current 50% DigitalBridge vehicle and 50% Macquarie side through MMIT I and II; the 2022 Macquarie-side transfer was internal, InfraBridge is not a direct owner, and no later platform exit or pending MTP transfer was found.
